input_only.population: positive rational perfect-cuboid endpoint modulo positive scaling and edge permutation
new_35ex33_invariant: g_AB=gcd(A,B), g_AC=gcd(A,C), g_BC=gcd(B,C) are pairwise coprime
every gcd ideal between distinct face Gaussians, with independent conjugation, is a square ideal
only the three private moving edge-gcd squareclasses remain at pairwise shared-prime level

blind_generation_rule: The candidates below were generated from the displayed endpoint equations and the 35EX-33 invariant only. Repository route names, historical route labels, and Arsenal recommendations were not consulted for candidate generation.

blind_candidates.name: PRIVATE_EDGE_GCD_TORSOR_DECOMPOSITION
blind_candidates.derivation: Set x=g_AB, y=g_AC, z=g_BC. Pairwise coprimality suggests the exact primitive decomposition A=x*y*a, B=x*z*b, C=y*z*c. Dividing the three face-square equations by x^2,y^2,z^2 gives three simultaneously primitive Pythagorean equations in y*a,z*b; x*a,z*c; x*b,y*c. The space-square condition then couples all six variables.
blind_candidates.test: prove the full coprimality dictionary for a,b,c,x,y,z and determine whether the fourth square forces a finite squareclass, parity, or descent condition not visible in pairwise Gaussian gcds

blind_candidates.name: JOINT_LOCAL_HILBERT_PROFILE_ON_PRIVATE_GCDS
blind_candidates.derivation: The three private squareclasses have disjoint rational support. Evaluate the three face equations plus the space equation simultaneously over Q_p at p|2xyz instead of pairwise Gaussian gcds.
blind_candidates.test: derive a source-independent product formula or incompatible local profile across all four quadratic equations

blind_candidates.name: GENUINE_V2_PROPAGATION_DESCENT
blind_candidates.derivation: Exactly one primitive edge is odd. The gcd of the two even edges carries the unique even private gcd channel. Track exact v2 through the three primitive face triples and the space-diagonal triple.
blind_candidates.test: prove a strict valuation increase under a canonical reconstruction, or else freeze the absence of a monotone descent quantity

blind_candidates.name: LINKED_TWO_COVERS_FROM_THREE_FACE_TRIPLES
blind_candidates.derivation: After private-gcd decomposition, three primitive Pythagorean triples share the six factors x,y,z,a,b,c. Their standard conic/2-cover parameters are therefore not independent.
blind_candidates.test: construct the linked 2-cover classes and ask whether the simultaneous image intersection is empty or smaller than the individual local images

blind_candidates.name: RATIO_BIQUARTIC_QUOTIENT
blind_candidates.derivation: Normalize one edge to 1 and parameterize one face Pythagorean condition. The other two face squares and the space square become coupled rational square conditions in the remaining ratio parameter(s), naturally producing biquadratic/biquartic quotients.
blind_candidates.test: find a quotient whose rational points exactly represent the endpoint receiver rather than a loose over-cover

blind_candidates.name: UNIFORM_ELLIPTIC_SURFACE_HEIGHT
blind_candidates.derivation: Fix one Pythagorean face parameter and retain another ratio as base. The remaining square conditions can produce genus-one fibers varying with the base.
blind_candidates.test: obtain a genuine nonisotrivial family with a source-locked endpoint section/cover and a uniform height or Mordell-Weil obstruction

blind_candidates.name: NONOBVIOUS_VERTICAL_BRAUER_ON_ENDPOINT_FIBRATION
blind_candidates.derivation: The four-square endpoint surface can be fibered by one ratio; pairwise Gaussian squareclasses being trivial does not preclude a vertical class depending on the private gcd/torsor coordinates.
blind_candidates.test: derive an explicit nonconstant class and compute its local evaluation on the exact endpoint image

blind_candidates.name: TERNARY_SPINOR_NORM_COMPATIBILITY
blind_candidates.derivation: The space square represents A^2+B^2+C^2 as a square while all three binary subforms are squares. This may impose a spinor-norm compatibility invisible to pairwise gcd support.
blind_candidates.test: construct an exact ternary-form obstruction with the face-square conditions retained, not merely the ambient sum-of-three-squares form

blind_candidates.name: SYMMETRIC_DIAGONAL_RATIO_INVARIANTS
blind_candidates.derivation: Use normalized face/space diagonal ratios and elementary symmetric functions to quotient edge permutation before further descent.
blind_candidates.test: check whether the symmetric quotient lowers dimension or creates a strict arithmetic constraint rather than repackaging the same endpoint surface

blind_candidates.name: MINIMUM_V2_EDGE_RECONSTRUCTION_DESCENT
blind_candidates.derivation: The endpoint has a canonical parity ordering: one odd edge and two even edges. Combine the unique parity gauge with rational reciprocal/Pythagorean reconstruction maps to seek a size- or valuation-decreasing self-map.
blind_candidates.test: prove an exact self-map preserving the endpoint population and a strictly decreasing positive invariant; otherwise block as gauge-only

blind_selection.reason: it directly attacks the exact residual information isolated by 35EX-33: the three private moving edge-gcd squareclasses. It also exposes the full simultaneous three-face structure before importing local, elliptic, or adelic machinery.
